items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: His style was something similar to Oscar Peterson

ctx.x: Martial was actually from Algeria. His style was something similar to Oscar Peterson, with a technique like the great Art Tatum and he accompanied me beautifully, although my style was not as modern as that of Dizzy Gillespie and others of that epoch. I really enjoyed playing with Martial who was full of ideas, very inspiring.

I stayed at the Ringside until the 4th of August and started at a place called Metro Jazz, which became the Trois Maillets (three hammers). This place was on the left bank in the Latin Quarter, near the famous Notre Dame church. I was living on the left bank and the Metro Jazz club was about 10 minutes walk from my hotel.
